candidates.name: QzSimple2
candidates.role: Shallow-footing q-z vertical bearing, uplift and cyclic settlement model
candidates.application: Distributed springs below a footing; not a material for each geological layer or bbarBrick.

proposed_layer_or_interface.location: At the footing underside, depth 3 m; represents equivalent response of the underlying layered ground
proposed_layer_or_interface.layer_context: 3–13 m blocky ejecta plus deeper support

candidates.name: ElasticPPGap
candidates.application: Simplified contact or equivalent vertical compression sensitivity. Accumulated settlement must be checked for the chosen rule.

proposed_layer_or_interface.location: Simplified compression-only contact; conditional normal opening/closure at explicit rock joints
proposed_layer_or_interface.layer_context: Contact/interface only; not a constitutive model for the entire 13–30 m rock layer

candidates.name: Hysteretic
candidates.role: Fit measured normal or shear cyclic response
candidates.application: Requires force–displacement calibration; no automatic confinement dependence.

proposed_layer_or_interface.location: Conditional fit to a duricrust normal/shear test or reduced response

candidates.name: QzSimple1
candidates.role: Established pile-tip q-z material studied in shallow-foundation BNWF
candidates.application: Reference comparison; original sand/clay pile backbones require adaptation for the ring footing.

proposed_layer_or_interface.location: Reference vertical spring comparison below the footing
proposed_layer_or_interface.layer_context: Equivalent support, not a distinct layer material

candidates.name: PySimple2
candidates.application: Complement to vertical springs for embedded footings; literature PxSimple1 terminology is not an accepted command in this installed engine.

proposed_layer_or_interface.location: Soil-contacting sides of an embedded footing, approximately 0–3 m
proposed_layer_or_interface.layer_context: Duricrust and sandy regolith where contact actually exists

candidates.name: TzSimple2
candidates.application: Needs interface friction calibration and treatment of reduced resistance during uplift; literature TxSimple1 terminology is not an accepted command in this installed engine.

proposed_layer_or_interface.location: Tangential direction of the footing underside at depth 3 m
